title: EBITDA normalization verification verdicts
description: What the self-verification pass returns: for every candidate on the schedule, whether the cited rows and excerpts support it as the add-back it claims to be, and why not when they do not. The verifier is a separate invocation that sees the schedule's amounts, citations and excerpts and never the first pass's rationale or confidence. A verdict is a boolean and a reason; there is no number in it.
